coverage: 12 city corporations and 320 municipalities across all 64 districts. Census 2022 jurisdictions, not a current legal-status inventory. Six municipal rows remain excluded: five unverified locations and one unnamed report row.
reuse: BBS retains copyright. Report page ii permits use for research and planning and publication of data with source acknowledgement; commercial reproduction of the publication is restricted.

definitions.households: General households (shared residence and meals), excluding institutional, other and floating households. Table P23/P25 column 3. Cantonment-area residents are reported separately; census jurisdictions may differ from current administrative extents.
definitions.householdSize: Mean people per general household. Table P23/P25 column 12.
definitions.literacy: Percent of people aged 7+ reported as literate in the jurisdiction. Table P23/P25 column 13.
definitions.population: Not included: P23/P25 population totals differ from headline totals; do not derive population by multiplying rounded household size by households.

geography.display: Fixed-size reference markers only. No jurisdiction boundary, built-up footprint or service catchment is displayed.
geography.municipalityVersion: BGD-ADM4-29066614 / commit 9469f09; metadata represents 2020 but legacy Mymensingh municipality predates city corporation.
geography.municipalityLicense: CC BY 3.0 IGO; BBS/OCHA ROAP via geoBoundaries.
geography.transformation: Named OSM place nodes, plus Dhaka North/South city-corporation offices, or interior points of licensed geoBoundaries municipality features. Match by census name and parent district, review transliteration aliases, and check each point inside the corresponding 2022 census GIS reference. Unnamed legacy municipality features require an unambiguous spatial match. Older polygons are not shipped.
geography.validationLimit: Unofficial census GIS mirror used only to validate parent IDs and point containment, not as the source of displayed statistics or coordinates. No geometry redistributed. Census codes are reference identifiers from this mirror; statistical rows are matched independently by report name and parent district. Bogura spans two upazila reference records and is counted once.

pointDataLicenses.openStreetMap: ODbL 1.0; source-linked records form the attributed OSM reference-location extract.

geography.locationService: https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter; cached offline queries, no runtime dependency.

verification.statistics: Every extracted household row reconciled with its ward rows; all city and municipality general-household subtotals reconcile with the P23/P25 national totals before exclusions. Reviewed table headers, wrapped labels and the unnamed municipal row visually.
verification.names: Bangla display names use reviewed OSM names or editorial transliterations of census names; place types follow Census 2022.
verification.geography: Every displayed point checked for containment in the matching 2022 reference jurisdiction; never borrow a neighbouring town or district centre.
